tokens.name: color-paper
tokens.usage: Page background and default surface. Body text and rules sit on it.

tokens.name: color-paper-2
tokens.usage: Raised or alternate surface (cards, inset bands) on `paper`.

tokens.name: color-paper-3
tokens.usage: Deepest surface step (wells, hovered rows) on `paper-2`.

tokens.name: color-rule
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders. Decorative, not a text colour; in Carnival it is an oxblood rule.

tokens.name: color-rule-2
tokens.usage: Stronger divider and control border on `paper`. Under 3:1 on `paper` in Specimen, Cobalt, Lumen, Hum and Grid, so never the only boundary of an input or control.

tokens.name: color-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and labels on `paper`, `paper-2`. 4.9:1 or better on `paper` in every theme except Cobalt (4.45:1, just under AA; use at 16px+ only or step to `neutral`).

tokens.name: color-neutral
tokens.usage: Tertiary body copy, between `muted` and `ink-2`, on `paper`.

tokens.name: color-ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary body copy on `paper`, `paper-2`, `paper-3`.

tokens.name: color-ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on `paper` and `paper-2`. 14.8:1 or better in every theme.

tokens.name: color-accent
tokens.usage: The one accent: links, active states, highlights, focus, single CTAs. At most 3% of any viewport. Reads under 4.5:1 as text on `paper` in Specimen (3.0), Cobalt (4.2), Carnival (1.2) and Hum (1.4): use it as a fill or large mark there, not for small text.

tokens.name: color-accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text colour for content sitting on an `accent` fill. Holds in Cobalt (4.25:1, slightly under AA), Carnival, Lumen, Hum and Grid. In Specimen and Midnight the source value is a deeper accent tone for text on `paper`, so do not use it on a fill: put `ink` on an accent fill in Specimen (5.5:1) and `paper` in Midnight (8.6:1; `ink` there is only 2.0:1).

tokens.name: color-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring colour (`:focus-visible`). 3:1 or better on `paper` in Midnight, Cobalt, Carnival, Lumen and Grid; Specimen is 3.03:1; Hum is 2.67:1, add a 2px `ink` offset ring there.

tokens.name: color-accent-2
tokens.usage: Second accent, Carnival and Lumen/Hum only. Pair with `accent` as a duo-tone; never a third accent hue.

tokens.name: color-accent-3
tokens.usage: Third accent, Hum only (a hot red-pink). Use for one badge or marker per view.

tokens.name: color-graphite
tokens.usage: Cobalt only: dark graphite fill for inverted bands and code wells.

tokens.name: color-mint
tokens.usage: Hum only: soft green tint for success-like highlights; pair with a word or icon, never colour alone.

tokens.name: color-lavender
tokens.usage: Hum only: soft violet tint for one decorative field per view.

tokens.name: color-glow
tokens.usage: Lumen only: accent glow behind a single hero element. Never on a body surface.

tokens.name: color-glow-2
tokens.usage: Lumen only: faint accent halo (12%) for focus or hover emphasis.

tokens.name: color-paper-emit
tokens.usage: Lumen only: 4% accent wash laid over `paper` to make a surface look lit.

tokens.name: color-accent-deep
tokens.usage: Hum only: deeper accent for text and icons on `paper`.

tokens.name: color-accent-2-deep
tokens.usage: Hum only: deeper second accent for text and icons on `paper`.

tokens.name: color-accent-3-deep
tokens.usage: Hum only: deeper third accent for text and icons on `paper`.

tokens.name: color-mint-deep
tokens.usage: Hum only: deeper mint for text and icons on `paper`.

tokens.name: color-lavender-deep
tokens.usage: Hum only: deeper lavender for text and icons on `paper`.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero statement, one per page. The source scales it fluidly from 3rem to 5.75rem (clamp 3rem, 5.5vw + 1rem, 5.75rem); 5.75rem is its ceiling. Weight 340 is Specimen; other themes set their own display weight (Midnight 300, Lumen 400, Hum 600, Cobalt 500, Carnival 700, Grid 800).

styles.name: display-s
styles.usage: Section-level display heading. Fluid in the source (clamp 2rem, 3vw + 1rem, 3rem); 3rem is its ceiling.

styles.name: text-3xl
styles.usage: Largest in-page heading below display. Line height uses lh-snug.

styles.name: text-base
styles.usage: Default body and UI text. Never set body copy below this on mobile.

styles.name: text-xs
styles.usage: Smallest text; labels and legal only, never running copy.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Mono label (tracking-label 0.12em), uppercase. For the outlier role only: wordmark, stat, one tag per view.

tokens.name: space-3xs
tokens.usage: Optical nudges, 2px.

tokens.name: space-2xs
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside a control.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Gap between related items.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Default gap and card padding.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Gap between groups in a section.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Section inner padding.

tokens.name: space-2xl
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks in a section.

tokens.name: space-3xl
tokens.usage: Large section rhythm.

tokens.name: space-4xl
tokens.usage: Hero top or bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-5xl
tokens.usage: Maximum vertical air, one per page.

tokens.name: section-gap
tokens.usage: Default vertical distance between page sections. Vary it; equal gaps read as a template.

tokens.name: section-head-gap
tokens.usage: Gap from a section heading to its content.

radius.note: Values shown are Specimen (square). Per theme: Cobalt card 10px, pill 6px, input 6px; Carnival 8px, 999px, 4px; Lumen 10px, 999px, 8px; Hum 20px, 999px, 12px; Grid, Midnight: square. Set the theme's values; never mix a round pill into a square theme.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, code blocks and install wells.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: CTAs, badges and dot indicators.

tokens.name: radius-input
tokens.usage: Form fields and single-line code.

rule.note: Border weights. Brutal-leaning themes go heavier: Carnival card rule 2px.

tokens.name: rule-hair
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between list rows.

tokens.name: rule-fine
tokens.usage: Default 1px divider and input border.

tokens.name: rule-card
tokens.usage: Card border thickness; 2px in Carnival.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Card depth. Most themes use none; Carnival uses a hard 4px offset, Lumen a soft deep drop, Hum a soft lift, Cobalt a 1px hairline lift.

tokens.name: z-base
tokens.usage: Default stacking.

tokens.name: z-raised
tokens.usage: Raised cards.

tokens.name: z-dropdown
tokens.usage: Dropdowns and menus.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: In-page sticky section heads; must dock under the nav.

tokens.name: z-sticky-nav
tokens.usage: Top nav and banner; above in-page sticky.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Modals and drawers.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts.

tokens.name: z-tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltips.

tokens: hallmark: site/css/tokens.css (themes specimen, midnight, cobalt, carnival, lumen, hum, grid)

fontSize.note: Size variables for CSS (var(--text-md)); the same steps exist as type styles and classes. display sizes are fluid.

tokens.name: text-sm

tokens.name: text-base
tokens.usage: Default body and UI text.

tokens.name: text-md
tokens.usage: Long-form reading text.

tokens.name: text-lg
tokens.usage: Lead paragraph.

tokens.name: text-xl

tokens.name: text-2xl
tokens.usage: Page heading in dense layouts.

tokens.name: text-3xl

tokens.name: text-display
tokens.usage: Fluid hero display size, one per page.

tokens.name: text-display-s
tokens.usage: Fluid section display size.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Maximum page width (Specimen). Grid theme narrows to 64rem.

tokens.name: page-gutter
tokens.usage: Left and right page padding; fluid.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Reading line length for body copy (Specimen). Other themes run 56ch to 70ch.

tokens.name: banner-height
tokens.usage: Height of the top banner. Every in-page sticky element offsets by it so it docks below the nav.

tokens.name: dur-micro
tokens.usage: Button press, toggle tick, color shift.

tokens.name: dur-short
tokens.usage: Hover lift, tooltip, menu open.

tokens.name: dur-long
tokens.usage: Modal, drawer, accordion, page reveal.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Elements entering.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Elements leaving.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: State toggles.
